global_style_suffix: Post-impressionist oil-painting look brought to life, thick visible impasto and swirling brush strokes, cinematic wide compositions, deep cobalt night blues with warm amber accents, soft film grain, painterly edges, museum-grade color harmony, emotionally reverent mood, no modern UI or text overlays.
global_style_suffix_zh: 后印象派油画质感、厚涂笔触与漩涡云层，电影宽幅构图，钴蓝夜空配琥珀色点缀，胶片微粒与画风边缘，庄重抒情，无现代界面与字幕。

structural_visual_rules.visual_tension_en: Contained, observational tension: wider compositions breathe—landscapes, skies, and painterly worlds dominate; emotion sits in stillness and gradual reveals rather than explosive peaks.
structural_visual_rules.visual_tension_zh: 主歌偏内敛与凝视：画面以远景与环境为主，情绪藏在缓慢的揭示里，而非一下子推到顶点。
structural_visual_rules.camera_framing_en: Favor medium-wide and extreme wide shots; slower pushes and gentle tilts; occasional intimate inserts (palette, linen, eyes) as punctuation.
structural_visual_rules.cut_motion_tempo_en: Fewer cuts; longer holds; camera moves glide with lyrical phrasing; motion reads like studying a canvas.
structural_visual_rules.contrast_vs_other_sections_en: Verses stay cooler in pacing and density compared to choruses—reserve maximal saturation and frontal graphic impact for refrains.

structural_visual_rules.visual_tension_en: Released, anthemic lift: chromatic intensity climbs—fuller skies, denser brush turbulence, faces and symbolic forms press closer to camera; emotional empathy becomes visually frontal.
structural_visual_rules.visual_tension_zh: 副歌释放张力：饱和度与笔触动能抬高，符号更贴近镜头，合唱句更像宣言性的画面爆发（仍保持油画媒介而非写实新闻片）。
structural_visual_rules.camera_framing_en: More heroic scales and upward angles; tighter clusters alternating with iconic wides; stronger symmetry or radial swirl motifs.
structural_visual_rules.cut_motion_tempo_en: Slightly higher cut cadence aligned to refrain repetition; bolder crane or orbit accents on hook lines.
structural_visual_rules.contrast_vs_other_sections_en: Choruses must feel visually louder than verses—more starfield motion, thicker pigment chaos, warmer accents—without switching to a different unrelated art style.

structural_visual_rules.visual_tension_en: Narrowed emotional corridor: sudden intimacy or stark metaphor imagery; brief reduction of scale before final escalation.
structural_visual_rules.visual_tension_zh: 桥段收窄情绪通道：更私密或更锋利的隐喻镜头，为尾声积蓄落差。
structural_visual_rules.camera_framing_en: Close proximity and shallow depth; isolated subjects against simplified backgrounds.
structural_visual_rules.cut_motion_tempo_en: Measured but uneasy pacing; fewer panoramic breathers.
structural_visual_rules.contrast_vs_other_sections_en: Reads as a hinge between verse contemplation and chorus declamation—distinct but still the same painted universe.

core_visual_motifs.prompt_anchor_en: swirling cobalt starfield with thick impasto spirals, luminous yellow stars, painterly night clouds
core_visual_motifs.motif_notes_zh: 贯穿「Starry starry night」 hook，是全片识别度最高的环境母题，必须在副歌反复召回。

core_visual_motifs.prompt_anchor_en: wooden palette, oil pigments mixing, brush bristles, linen canvas texture dissolving into landscape
core_visual_motifs.motif_notes_zh: 对应「palette blue and grey」与作画行为，主歌阶段建立「画中之境」的规则。

core_visual_motifs.prompt_anchor_en: red-bearded painter in paint-stained coat, candlelit studio, intense concentration at easel
core_visual_motifs.motif_notes_zh: 承载叙事凝视的对象，可不每张脸清晰，但须在关键句反复暗示同一人物身份与衣着锚点。

core_visual_motifs.prompt_anchor_en: museum-white corridors, gilt frames, painted eyes watching from canvases in dim spotlight
core_visual_motifs.motif_notes_zh: 歌词后期「empty halls / frameless heads」对应后置段落的核心视觉转向，需与户外星空形成空间对立。

animation_art_style_en: Living canvas: Van Gogh inspired worlds where paint texture stays readable on every surface; transitions feel like dissolves through wet pigment rather than hard CGI plastic.
lighting_mood_en: Self-luminous stars and windows against blue darkness; intimate interiors lit by single warm sources with gentle falloff.
texture_material_en: Oil paint impasto, canvas weave subtly visible, light atmospheric haze, restrained analog grain.
motion_camera_en: Slow dolly and crane moves, minimal handheld; rhythmic cuts aligned to emotional peaks rather than frantic shake.
art_direction_summary_zh: 以梵高绘画语言统一全片视觉：星空与麦田等意象以「活起来的油画」呈现；主歌克制凝视、副歌抬升色彩与动能；调色板—星空—肖像廊形成三条反复出现的母题轴；冷暖对比控制情绪；镜头沉稳、尊重民谣叙事节奏。
